title: Loud horn, cab not stated
why: 98 dB fails the cab limit if the unit has a cab, and the spec does not say.

noise.cab_standstill_horn_db.required: ≤ 95 dB, for a unit fitted with a cab
noise.cab_standstill_horn_db.rationale: Noise TSI 4.2.4 Table 5 (cab, for units fitted with a cab: standstill with horns 95 dB; at vmax 78 dB if vmax < 250 km/h, 80 dB if 250 ≤ vmax < 350 km/h): has_drivers_cab is not supplied and 98 > 95.
